note: Model-visible schemas extracted from ctx.tools.schemas() at runtime — always matches the shipped code.

tools.name: demo_rolling_sum
tools.description: Sum the last `window` values at each index (rolling sum). Output length equals input length; the first window-1 positions are null. An empty series is a legal result, not an error.

tools.name: demo_series_stats
tools.description: Compute count/mean/min/max of a number series. An empty series is legal: count=0 and the statistics are null.
